name: job-search-toolkit
description: An AI job-search partner for senior leaders: career evidence, job screening, truthful tailored CVs and tracked applications.

interface.shortDescription: Your AI partner for a senior job search
interface.longDescription: Builds a private career evidence bank from your CV, LinkedIn export and a guided career interview. Then it screens roles against your criteria, tailors truthful CVs for each one, has them reviewed independently, and tracks applications. Everything stays in a private folder on your computer, and it never applies anywhere without your explicit permission.
defaultPrompt: Is this job a good fit for me?
Tailor my CV for this role
